dimensions.assessment: Affects local entities, users of Okhissa Lake recreation areas, and federal land management agencies in Franklin County, Mississippi.
dimensions.evidence: National Forest System land located in Franklin County, Mississippi

dimensions.assessment: Transfers ownership of approximately 310.7 acres of federal land, transfers dam maintenance liability, and restricts future subdivision.
dimensions.evidence: convey... all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to the surface estate

dimensions.assessment: Requires cash consideration equal to fair market value and payment of appraisal/survey costs, with proceeds used for National Forest land acquisition.
dimensions.evidence: in an amount equal to the fair market value of the National Forest System land being conveyed

dimensions.assessment: Applies a specific land conveyance, use restrictions, and environmental law exemptions to a localized tract of federal land.
dimensions.evidence: direct the Secretary of Agriculture to convey certain National Forest System land located in Franklin County

dimensions.assessment: Permanent transfer of land title with perpetual reservations, easements, and restrictive covenants.
dimensions.evidence: a perpetual, nonexclusive road right-of-way... a restrictive covenant against the subdivision

missing_information: Exact dollar amount of the fair market value of the land
importance_detail.rationale: This bill directs the conveyance of specific National Forest System land in Mississippi to a state instrumentality for public recreation, subject to specific conditions, environmental exemptions, and dam maintenance responsibilities.
